# hermes-lcm-ledger v0.1.0-rc.1

First Ledger release candidate from Benjamin Wittorf's PR #589, based on
Hermes-LCM by Stephen Schoettler and contributors. Preserves the engine key
`lcm`, all 15 tool names, `lcm.db` and existing external payload references.
Includes upstream's skill registration fix, managed turn-hook registration
and serialized message-store backup and shutdown. See the operator guide
for switching the enabled plugin and rolling back.
